preconditions.description: The number of balls n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of swaps m must be between 1 and 200,000.
The initial position of the special ball k must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in swaps)
preconditions.description: Each swap must involve two distinct positions within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and (x >= 0 or x == -1) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output must be an integer, either non-negative or -1.
There must be at least one position where the special ball can end up without faking any swaps.
